title: Fall Connect Day Connects Angelenos With Help That Matters
description:
Community members gathered at St. Joseph Center for Fall Connect Day, a free resource event connecting individuals and families with services, information, and support.

Local organizations and government agencies worked side by side to help attendees access resources related to mental health, public benefits, housing, and other community needs. Participating partners included the Los Angeles County Department of Public Social Services, the Department of Mental Health, Council District 11, and community and corporate partners. Free haircuts were also available during the event.

St. Joseph Center provides a wide range of services for people experiencing homelessness and low-income residents, including outreach, housing assistance, benefits advocacy, case management, and connections to additional support.

Events like Fall Connect Day bring multiple resources together in one place, making it easier for community members to connect with services and organizations that may be able to help.
